messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring partial-stream responses and timeouts across EU/US yesterday during the 08:30-11:00 UTC window. Pattern: long token generations (>22s) then RST/GOAWAY from edge proxies. Need owners for short/medium-term mitigations.

maria: Thanks. We saw a ~11% drop in webchat completion for affected cohorts. Can we aim for a 48h mitigation plan?

lee: TL;DR: short-term: bump proxy idle timeout + increase keepalive; mid-term: SDK resume + jittered backoff; long-term: predictive early chunking in runtime to keep streams active.

sagar: Confirmed envoy logs show `RST_STREAM reason=idle_timeout` and occasional `GOAWAY` during long gens. Example: 
```
2026-04-01T09:04:12Z proxy envoy upstream reset: RST_STREAM id=12345 reason=idle_timeout request=gh-77
```
No app-level pings during generation.

oliver: Ops can run a canary for timeout bump but we need a narrow blast radius and rollback plan. Suggest per-region incremental canary and monitor `streaming.partial_rate`.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5032 "streaming - edge timeout canary (EU first)" assigned to ops-oncall. Link: https://tickets/INF-5032

lee: I'll open a client SDK PR to add resume-token handling + exponential backoff with randomized jitter. Plan: include a canary flag and tests against our flaky-harness. ETA PR: 2026-04-02 EOD.

sagar: I'll prototype HTTP/2 PING keepalive in the runtime and run it in staging. Early run reduced resets from ~9/hr to ~2/hr in staging. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/789

maria: Action items (with owners / ETA):
- ACT-01: Edge idle-timeout canary (EU) + rollback plan 1 owner: ops 1 due: 2026-04-02
- ACT-02: Runtime keepalive (HTTP/2 PING) + staging validation 1 owner: sagar 1 due: 2026-04-04
- ACT-03: SDK resume + jittered backoff + canary flag 1 owner: lee 1 due: 2026-04-06
- ACT-04: Metric & alert `streaming.partial_rate` by route/model 1 owner: sam 1 due: 2026-04-03
- ACT-05: Canary rollout playbook and oncall runbook update 1 owner: oliver 1 due: 2026-04-02

sam: I'll add the dashboard and alert. Will tune thresholds to avoid noisy pages during the canary.

oliver: Ops can take the EU window 2026-04-02 01:00-02:00 UTC. Rolling to US and APAC if metrics look stable.

maria: I'll maintain the shared checklist and run weekly sync until closed. First sync: 2026-04-03 10:00 UTC. Please update the checklist when you start work.

lee: Note: SDK change must guarantee idempotent resume semantics. We'll use a monotonic resume cursor and tests in integration harness.

sagar: Also recommend adding chunk-interval histogram and a `streaming.partial_chunk_count` metric to classify partial vs abort.

maria: Good point. Add that to ACT-04.

sam: Filing a small P0 milestone in the tracker to ensure prioritization. Link: https://tracker/RED-1589

maria: Thanks team. Closing thread for updates; please reply here if blocked. We'll reopen if canary shows regressions. :white_check_mark:
